runtime.auth: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY environment variable; never written to a record or log

model.note: The output ceiling is an operational limit, not a prose target. A unit that cannot discharge its obligations within the ceiling is split on concept boundaries and resumed; it is never compressed to fit. Any model change requires re-validation on held-out fixtures per contract change_rule.

sampling.rationale: Lowest-variance sampling for repeatable structure. Reproducibility is behavioral, not bitwise: the same brief and model version satisfy the same declared properties, but token sequences may differ.

v1_critic.note: Retained for audit of v1 runs.

v2_extraction.note: WP-V2-1 deliverable. Extracts concepts from source spans with reader profile and genre.

v2_reconstruction.note: WP-V2-2 deliverable. Reconstruction critic for concept verification.

v2_coverage.note: WP-V2-3 deliverable. Coverage critic for gap detection.

v2_rewrite.note: WP-V2-4 deliverable. Rewriting prompt with concept preservation constraints.

declared_properties: schema conformance against the shared registry in src/humanvoice/schemas.py
abstention when source evidence is missing or contradictory
unresolved rather than partial credit on uncertain concept correspondence
split-and-resume rather than compression when a unit exceeds the output estimate
register compliance with the declared voice in the humanization brief
mutation response: graceful abstention or downstream-detectable failure on corrupted input
reproducibility.limitation_disclosure: An auditor can re-run the property suite against the declared model version. An auditor cannot cryptographically verify the token sequence of a historical run.

isolation.model_output_handling: delimited JSON validated against the target schema before use; validation failure produces abstention, never execution
isolation.network: API egress to the declared endpoint only; parser and compiler remain network-denied
isolation.secrets: API key read from the environment; excluded from run manifests, findings, and CLI stdout
isolation.rationale: The T4 authority boundary is unchanged. T3 permits logged API egress for prose generation while keeping untrusted-code execution paths isolated.

budget.on_exceeded: pause and require explicit continuation authorization; record the limit. A resource limit never authorizes deleting a concept, shortening an explanation, or releasing an incomplete revision.
budget.note: These are operational controls only. No field in this object is a prose length target, and none may be used to justify semantic compression.

segmentation.rule: A pre-call estimate above this figure forces decomposition on concept and dependency boundaries. It is a segmentation trigger, never a maximum or a target for the produced prose.

local_fallback.status: available but not the main path

grammars.note: These grammars encode the superseded v1 plan/draft/repair records. They cannot constrain a v2 call and must be replaced before the fallback is used in a v2 run.

local_fallback.note: Retained for offline work. Prose quality at 3B is not publishable and no release claim may rest on it.

verification.result: profile specified for contract 2.0.0; no v2 property validation or critic calibration has been run
verification.observation: The v1 profile asserted profile_status ready and g2_readiness ready against a contract that no longer governs. Those claims are withdrawn. This profile records only what is specified: runtime identity, isolation, operational limits, and the segmentation trigger.
verification.next_action: Implement the v2 templates and property suite under WP-V2-1 through WP-V2-4, then record held-out calibration evidence for every model-dependent critic before it enters the release path.
